2607.12048.title: An Empirical Analysis of Continual Learning for Heterogeneous Medical Visual Question Answering
2607.12048.paper_summary: Deploying medical visual question answering (MedVQA) systems in real-world clinical settings requires models that adapt to new clinical tasks without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. Continual learning (CL) provides a practical framework for this setting. Despite rapid progress in medical vision-language models, the behavior of CL methods when training these models across heterogeneous MedVQA tasks remains underexplored. This work presents a systematic evaluation of CL for MedVQA across diverse clinical objectives, including classification, multi-label classification, detection, cell counting, and report generation. Specifically, we explore (1) the ability of existing CL methods to mitigate catastrophic forgetting; (2) their sensitivity to task ordering, analyzing how different task sequences influence performance retention and forgetting; and (3) the evolution of low-rank adaptation parameters as new tasks are learned, revealing patterns of weight drift under different CL methods. Our findings suggest that existing CL methods struggle to maintain stability-plasticity balance when tasks with different objectives and supervision formats are interleaved. Code and full experimental setup will be publicly available.
2607.12048.paper_summary_zh: 部署醫療視覺問答（MedVQA）系統於現實臨床環境中，需要能夠適應新臨床任務而不忘記先前獲得知識的模型。持續學習（CL）為這種情境提供了一個實用的框架。儘管醫療視覺語言模型的進展迅速，但在異質性 MedVQA 任務中訓練這些模型時，CL 方法的行為仍然未被充分探索。本研究對 MedVQA 在多樣臨床目標下的 CL 進行了系統評估，包括分類、多標籤分類、檢測、細胞計數和報告生成。具體而言，我們探討了（1）現有 CL 方法減輕災難性遺忘的能力；（2）它們對任務順序的敏感性，分析不同任務序列如何影響性能保留和遺忘；以及（3）隨著新任務的學習，低秩適應參數的演變，揭示在不同 CL 方法下權重漂移的模式。我們的發現表明，當不同目標和監督格式的任務交錯時，現有 CL 方法難以維持穩定性與可塑性之間的平衡。代碼和完整實驗設置將公開提供。
